speaker: will_kemp
text: You are abroad with the parish. I am abroad because a child is dancing as if the ground were a debt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let her dance. It is May Day.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Again, then. The foot goes so, and the other foot does not apologise.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have improved it. An improvement asked twice becomes a trade.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Give her the second, Will, and come. The house is up the hill, and a lane will hire you if you stand in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will do it again. She asked. On a May morning a man does not refuse a child a second foot.

speaker: will_kemp
text: There. Again is done. I am going up to the house. I am not a garland.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The garland went through the dirt held high. The flowers did not pay the road.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Hold them how you like. I am not carrying one. Come, both of you.
